traps.note: The reproduction (an export into a folder of the customer's that is a link to a server directory) is the advisory's own route; a one-bug version would carry it verbatim.
Nothing says the destination may not exist yet or that a link may lead to another link; only the containment property reaches it.
No mention of the stored task row or the consumer trusting it; the “request or value … not carried out” wording is generic refusal-form boilerplate.
No mention of working directories or links planted below a destination inside the folder; only the general property covers it.

traps.quote: Froxlor must never affect anything outside a customer's own folder on that customer's behalf
traps.note: The invariant is stated for Froxlor as a whole, widening past the export feature to the separate statistics ownership pass that only a hidden trap occupies.
